[BBC Business] Banks expect to be hit in Budget tax raid
Senior banking executives have told the BBC they expect to be "on the menu" in a Budget tax raid later this month.

[BBC Business] Nandy 'minded to intervene' in Sky's £1.6bn takeover of ITV entertainment arm
The culture secretary says the deal could affect free expression in the media and the variety of Britain's news landscape.

[BBC Business] AI giant Anthropic woos potential investors ahead of stock market debut
It comes as some investors have become concerned about the amount of money being spent on AI infrastructure.

[BBC Business] 'I paid thousands to a company for jobs that never came'

[CNBC] Nvidia, AMD, Dell sell-off in global tech rout on AI funding worries
A sell-off in global technology hardware stocks deepened Thursday.

[CNBC] Wholesale prices jumped 6.3% annually in September, biggest gain since 2022
September producer prices were expected to increase 0.6% month over month and 5.5% annually, according to the consensus estimate by Dow Jones.

[CNBC] Southwest is overhauling its frequent flyer program. Here's what's changing
Southwest Airlines is overhauling its loyalty program and replacing A-List and A-List Preferred with three new tiers.

[CNBC] CoreWeave credit default swaps hit distress levels as investors sour on AI debt
Signs of distressed deepened in CoreWeave on Thursday.

[MarketWatch] My sister moved in with our mother, 78, and says she deserves the $925,000 family home. Is she right?
“The house is worth $925,000 and mom owns it outright. She also has $480,000 in investments.”

[MarketWatch] ‘I like the idea of a big return’: My financial adviser wants me to invest $350,000 in a UAE data center. Is this risky?
“I know you’re not supposed to put money you can’t afford to lose into speculative stuff.”

[MarketWatch] Did this year’s COLA beat inflation? Here’s how spending by American seniors stacks up so far in 2026.
The cost-of-living adjustment for 2027 will be 3.6%, which will give Social Security recipients an average of $75 more per month.

[MarketWatch] The COLA wars are coming for Social Security
The annual cost-of-living adjustment may soon be capped, curtailed, means-tested or scrapped altogether under various proposals being actively considered
